The diff shows no `rescue_from` or explicit handling in the controller to return a defined status/body tailored for embed/iframe consumers; the spec only asserts “not success” without checking the response shape/status. This is a concrete, diff-grounded UX/API-contract concern rather than a correctness defect for valid requests (embed.js always supplies `embed_url`).
